characterList.description: A man with long brown hair tied in a ponytail, brown beard and glasses. Wears a black jacket and a grey scarf.
characterList.name: Drew

characterList.description: A man wearing a brown jacket, black pants, a green beanie and sunglasses.
characterList.name: Tom

characterList.description: A man with brown beard. He wears an orange beanie, a black jacket and gloves.
characterList.name: Dick

characterList.description: A man with dark hair and beard. He wears a red shirt under a black fleece jacket.
characterList.name: Jon

content_metadata.description: Join a group of friends on their adventurous winter camping trip as they navigate snowy roads, enjoy camaraderie, and explore the beauty of nature.

qAndA.question: What is the name of the YouTube channel featured in the video?

qAndA.answer: They use a large, green canvas tent with a wood-burning stove for heat.
qAndA.question: What type of tent do the friends use for their winter camping trip?

qAndA.answer: Dick's first tip is to stick to the center of the path that has been blazed by snowmobiles to avoid slipping off into deep snow.
qAndA.question: What is Dick's first tip for driving on snowy trails?

qAndA.answer: Jon brings 'hashtag steaks of Diego,' which are presumably venison steaks.
qAndA.question: What kind of steaks does Jon bring for dinner?

qAndA.answer: They are using a map because they don't have cell phone service at the campsite.
qAndA.question: Why are Tom and Jon using a map instead of their phones for navigation?

characterInteraction.description: Drew, Tom, and Dick try to dig the Jeep out of the snow and joke about the situation.

scenes.contextualRelevance: A group of friends camping together enjoying winter activities.

narrativeProgression.description: Drew welcomes the viewers to "Snow Camp 2019" and introduces the setting and the other characters.
Drew introduces Tom and explains that they had a fun time getting to the camp.
Drew explains that they are trying to dig the Jeep out of the snow in order to find a cell phone signal and their friend John.
Drew explains that he needs to start a fire and cook food and encourages the viewers to check out footage of their arrival.
The scene ends with a footage of a Jeep driving on a snowy road at night.

scenes.title: Arrival and Day Activities

videoEditingDetails.description: The scene switches between different footages of the same day, filmed by different characters and with different devices.

characterInteraction.description: The friends reunite at the camp and enjoy having dinner and beer together.

narrativeProgression.description: Drew and Dick arrive at the camp, where Tom is waiting for them.
Drew is breaking firewood to make a fire inside the tent.
John arrives at the camp.
John explains his adventurous drive to the camp.
The friends have dinner and beer together.

Drew, Tom, and John drive off in the Jeep.

youtube_description:
Drew, Dick, and Jon are joined by the newest crew member Tom as they experience the trails of the Huron National Forest in the winter time. Enjoy their trials and tribulations digging cars from the snow. Then join them in Fort GreenBear for a warm fire, hot meals, and some laughs on the side. Watch as they saddle up for the real adventure, when Tom takes Drew and Jon to find new ways into their hunting fields to recover the treestands from deer season. 

Thanks for watching! Please remember to give this video a thumbs up and SUBSCRIBE to our channel.
